content.title: Protection Lull | Delayed Gentle Reversal
content.summary: A protective prop first reads as necessary, then a brief lull tempts an adult operator to move it aside; the camera holds a confident exposed interval before the same environment delivers one delayed benign material burst and an immediately readable reaction.

quick_start.input_format: Establish active shelter and a stable external material source in one shared geography. + Show the protection being deliberately removed, then a short confidently exposed action before the burst. + The late burst comes from the already established environment and leaves a persistent changed material state and visible reaction.
quick_start.recommended_input: At a bright professional pastry demonstration, an adult baker works under a transparent, shallow-sloped receiving hood hinged above the counter between the flour hopper and both baker and cake. The motor falls silent; she waits for loose flour on the hood to settle, then tilts the hood toward a built-in catch tray and swings it up sideways, checks that the cake is clear, and steps forward smiling to reveal it. A delayed latch in the same visible hopper releases one harmless flour cascade onto the now-open counter and her apron. She freezes, eyebrows raised, with the hood still raised and the new white flour accumulated below.
required_anchors: 同一环境给出延迟回击
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A protective prop first reads as necessary, then a brief lull tempts an adult operator to move it aside; the camera holds a confident exposed interval before the same environment delivers one delayed benign material burst and an immediately readable reaction.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A protective prop first reads as necessary, then a brief lull tempts an adult operator to move it aside; the camera holds a confident exposed interval before the same environment delivers one delayed benign material burst and an immediately readable reaction.

invariants.rule: Establish active shelter and a stable external material source in one shared geography.
invariants.purpose: Makes protection and later exposure physically intelligible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without visible initial protection, the late burst becomes generic slapstick.

invariants.rule: Show the protection being deliberately removed, then a short confidently exposed action before the burst.
invariants.ablation_failure: If burst arrives at the exact instant of removal, there is no reversal beat.

invariants.rule: The late burst comes from the already established environment and leaves a persistent changed material state and visible reaction.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated surprise or instantly dry reset breaks payoff continuity.

slots.name: adult_operator
slots.constraint: Unambiguously adult practitioner with a task.

slots.name: shelter
slots.constraint: One movable protective prop with visible open/closed or in/out state.

slots.name: hazard_source
slots.constraint: Visible, harmless material source established before lull.

slots.name: confident_action
slots.constraint: Brief task advance after removing shelter.

slots.name: late_burst
slots.constraint: Single delayed event from same source.

slots.name: material
slots.constraint: Physical flour, paper, mist or another benign medium.

anti_copy_exclusions: No student-coded uniform, youthful anime face, burgundy umbrella, maple street or exact rain splash pose.
No sexualized youthful framing; all transfer performers are clearly adult.
Do not add a fabricated weather forecast or claim intentional sabotage.

instantiations.prompt_seed: Adult pastry demo, shallow sloped overhead receiving hood between hopper and work area, catch tray, hood raised, proud cake reveal, delayed benign flour cascade.

instantiations.concept: At an adult puppetry rehearsal, a stage maker waits under a clear safety canopy while a confetti test rig runs. The rig becomes quiet, she swings the canopy aside and steps forward to inspect a puppet. A delayed last batch of paper strips drops from the visible overhead chute; she stops with an exaggerated surprised look while the strips pile around the puppet stand.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Adult puppet stage, safety canopy, quiet paper-strip test rig, canopy aside, brief inspection, delayed confetti fall.

failure_modes.failure: Delayed burst comes from an unseen new device.
failure_modes.repair: Show the hopper/chute before the lull and retain its spatial position.

failure_modes.failure: No time between removal and burst.
failure_modes.repair: Give one clear confident task action and facial shift before the late event.

failure_modes.failure: Subject and prop become clean again immediately.
failure_modes.repair: Hold the deposited material, open shield and startled performer in one final frame.
